title: Moroccan Egg Salad
subtitle: with preserved lemon, olives and red onion
description: Hard-boiled eggs piled with red chilli, onion, preserved lemon, green olives and parsley, dressed with a sharp lemon and olive oil dressing.

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs: place cold eggs in a pot, cover with tap water, bring to the boil and cook for 5 minutes for a bright yellow yolk, up to 10 minutes for fully set eggs. Cool under cold running water, crack and peel, and cut into quarters.
Arrange the eggs on a flat serving plate and scatter over the onion rings, sliced chilli, roughly chopped preserved lemon, the halved pitted olives and chopped parsley.
Shake the olive oil, lemon juice, sugar, salt and pepper in a covered jar until the sugar and salt dissolve. Spoon the dressing over the salad without stirring and serve immediately.
